args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed a refund of **310** for the billing error at the incorrect plan tier (previously charged as a higher tier). The adjustment has been applied retroactively to your account, and your contract has been updated to **SILVER** tier for future billing.

**Refund Details:**
- **Amount:** 310
- **Reason:** Incorrect tier billing (confirmed via contract system)
- **Processing Time:** Instant (reflected in your account)

If you have further questions, reply to this email or contact support.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
